The error indicates the document wasn't wrapped in a fenced code block. The content itself is valid FigDown — it just needs to be properly formatted for delivery. Here is the corrected document:

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 flowchart
title "Change request procedure"

process receive "Receive request"
process validate "Validate"
decision isvalid "Valid?"
process apply "Apply change"
terminator confirm "Confirm success"
terminator rollback "Rollback"

receive -> validate
validate -> isvalid
isvalid -> apply "yes"
apply -> confirm
isvalid -> rollback "no"

group changewindow "change window"
  validate
  apply
```

The flowchart shows the complete change request procedure:
1. A request is received
2. It's validated against policy
3. If valid (yes branch), the change is applied and success is confirmed
4. If invalid (no branch), a rollback is executed instead

The `group` construct encloses the validate and apply steps in a bordered box labeled "change window" to highlight which operations occur during the scheduled maintenance window.
